website.title: 웹사이트 설정
website.announcementEnabledDescription: When enabled, the announcement text is shown as a banner on the home and mailbox pages
website.allowRegistrationDescription: When disabled, the registration tab is hidden and new sign-ups are rejected
website.maintenanceModeDescription: When enabled, non-Emperor users cannot create mailboxes (503 with the maintenance message)
website.maintenanceMessagePlaceholder: Enter the message shown during maintenance
website.allowPermanentEmailDescription: When disabled, non-Emperor users cannot create permanent mailboxes and the option is hidden
website.pollIntervalSecondsDescription: How often the message list refreshes, 3–120 seconds

turnstile.enableDescription: 활성화되면 사용자 이름/비밀번호 로그인 및 회원가입에 Turnstile 인증이 필요합니다
turnstile.secretKeyDescription: 활성화하기 전에 Cloudflare에서 Turnstile 애플리케이션을 설정하고 필요한 키를 제공하세요

website.roleLimitsDescription: Set email limits per role. A per-user limit takes precedence. Leave blank to unset (emperor defaults to unlimited; other roles fall back to the global limit).
website.saveOrphanMailsDescription: When on, mail sent to a mailbox that does not exist is saved; if that mailbox is created later, the saved mail appears in it. When off, such mail is discarded.
website.keepMailsOnDelete: Keep mail when a mailbox is deleted
website.keepMailsOnDeleteDescription: When on, deleting a mailbox keeps its mail; recreating the same address later restores it. When off, mail is deleted together with the mailbox.
website.mailboxTrashEnabledDescription: When enabled, deleting a mailbox moves it to the trash (soft delete) first: users choose trash or permanent deletion, admins can restore or purge from the trash panel, and entries past the retention period are purged automatically. When disabled, deletion behaves as before.
website.trashRetentionDaysDescription: How long soft-deleted mailboxes and orphan messages are kept before the scheduled cleanup purges them permanently. Range 1-3650 days.
website.expiredTrashDefault: Move to Trash on Expiry (site default)
website.expiredTrashDefaultDescription: Site-wide default for whether expired mailboxes move to the trash; users can override it in their profile. Only applies when the mailbox trash is enabled.

promote.title: 역할 관리
promote.searchPlaceholder: 사용자 이름, 이메일 또는 이름으로 검색
promote.deleteConfirm: 사용자 {name}을(를) 삭제하시겠습니까? 이 사용자의 모든 이메일, 메시지 등의 데이터가 영구적으로 삭제되며 복구할 수 없습니다.

userManagement.title: User Management
userManagement.emailLimitHint: Leave blank to clear the per-user limit and fall back to role/global rules.
userManagement.invalidEmailLimit: Email limit must be an integer between 1 and 100000, or blank
userManagement.newPasswordPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep current password
userManagement.accessKeyDescription: Once set, the key (sent via the x-admin-access-key header) grants session-less access to any user's mail space. Only the SHA-256 hash is stored; a lost key can only be rotated.
userManagement.accessKeyPlaceholder: Enter a new key (at least 12 characters)
userManagement.accessKeyTooShort: Key must be at least 12 characters

space.title: User Mail Space (Admin)
space.keyDescription: Your session has no admin permission. Enter the special access key set by the administrator to open this user's mail space.
space.selectEmailFirst: Select an email on the left first
space.noEmails: This user has no emails yet
space.deleteEmailConfirm: Delete email {address}? All messages under it will be permanently deleted.

mailStats.title: Mail statistics
mailStats.description: Site-wide mailbox and mail overview, with quick cleanup for orphan mail, old mail and expired mailboxes.
mailStats.orphansOldDescription: Delete orphan mail older than 30 days.
mailStats.orphansAllDescription: Orphan mail has no owning mailbox (saved when the mailbox did not exist, or kept when a mailbox was deleted).
mailStats.oldMessagesDescription: Delete mail older than 90 days inside mailboxes (orphan mail not included).
mailStats.expiredMailboxesDescription: Delete expired mailboxes now; when Keep mail on delete is on, their mail is kept as orphan mail.

trash.title: Mailbox Trash
trash.description: Soft-deleted mailboxes (with their messages) are kept for a while. Restore or permanently delete them here; entries past the retention period are purged automatically.
trash.confirmPurgeDescription: This will permanently delete {address} and its {count} messages.

expiredTrash.title: Mailbox Expiry
expiredTrash.label: Move my mailboxes to the trash when they expire
expiredTrash.description: When enabled, your expired mailboxes are moved to the trash and an admin can restore them during the retention period. When disabled, the site retention rules apply (messages kept as orphans or deleted with the mailbox).
expiredTrash.followingDefault: Not set individually; following the site default ({state})
expiredTrash.customSet: Set individually; not following the site default
